_comment: The games hub (/games/) lists these in order. url is where the game is played; project is its write-up on this site, if it has one; status is the card's tag; image is optional (16:9 crop). A game uploaded into its own folder also needs that folder added to HOSTED_GAME in src/.htaccess, so returning players get new uploads.

games.title: IT Dungeon
games.description: Defend a breached network with a weapon made of real Python. Plays in a phone's browser, with optional Security+, Networking, and Linux questions.

games.title: Mitchtopia
games.description: A greybox room-clearer: three classes, a dash, and a door once the room is clear. Coloured blocks stand in for the art. Keyboard or touch.
